name: Trundle
title: the Troll King

Q.name: Chomp
Q.description: Trundle's next Attack deals 10/30/50/70/90 + 1.15/1.25/1.35/1.45/1.55×AD physical damage and briefly Slows by 75%, then Trundle gains 20/25/30/35/40 Attack Damage for 5 seconds and the enemy loses 10/12.5/15/17.5/20 Attack Damage for the same duration.
Q.summary: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

W.name: Frozen Domain
W.description: Trundle freezes an area for 8 seconds. While inside he gains 20/28.0/36/44/52% Move Speed, 30/50/70/90/110.0% Attack Speed, and 25% increased healing.
W.summary: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

E.name: Pillar of Ice
E.description: Trundle creates an icy pillar for 6 seconds, briefly Knocking Back enemies directly over it and Slowing nearby enemies by 34/38/42/46/50%.
E.summary: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

R.name: Subjugate
R.description: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing 0.2/0.25/0.3 + 0.0×AP max Health magic damage and stealing 40% Armor and Magic Resist over 5 seconds.
R.summary: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

Passive.name: King's Tribute
Passive.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.
Passive.summary: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Trundle is a bruiser who steals enemy stats with Chomp and Subjugate, making him a duelist against tanks. He plays top or jungle, wins with a quick Q trade and blocks paths with his Pillar of Ice.
strengths: Chomp steals attack damage and slows, winning short trades.
Subjugate deals % max HP damage and steals 40% of the target's armor and magic resist, so he beats tanks.
Pillar of Ice blocks paths and knocks back, setting up ganks or escapes.
Frozen Domain gives attack speed and heals in his zone.
Strong split pusher and tower taker.
weaknesses: No dash: easy to kite with range and mobility.
Pillar can be avoided with dashes.
Weaker against champions who don't build resistances.
His teamfight value comes mostly from his ultimate.

curve.lvl1: good – Chomp trades well with auto attacks
curve.lvl2: good – Q plus auto attack is a strong trade
curve.lvl3: strong – Pillar of Ice with Q gives a good all-in
curve.lvl6: very strong – Subjugate wins nearly any fight with a tank
curve.items: medium – first item: Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King for damage; tank items in the jungle
curve.late: good – strong split pusher, still good against tanks

profile.curveNote: Trundle's Chomp gives strong trades from level 1, and he gets much stronger at 6 when he can steal stats.
profile.waveClear: Good: Q and W clear waves.
profile.sustain: High: W heals and passive heals on monster deaths.
profile.mobility: Low: Pillar can block; no dash.

keyAbilities.engage: E (Pillar of Ice) to block or knock back
keyAbilities.answers: None. Trundle has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: King's Tribute: heals when an enemy near him dies.

Q.answer: Jax E dodges; Fiora W parries.
Q.notes: Chomp: his next attack deals bonus damage, briefly slows, and steals attack damage.

W.notes: Frozen Domain: a zone giving him move speed, attack speed and healing.

E.answer: Walk away; dashes can go over the pillar.
E.notes: Pillar of Ice: a pillar that knocks back enemies on top and slows around it.

R.notes: Subjugate: drains % max HP as magic damage and steals 40% armor and magic resist over 5 seconds. Strongest on tanks.

profile.windowAgainst: Trundle's window is when his Q or Pillar is on cooldown: kite him and avoid fighting tanks into his Subjugate.
